title: Crystal Angel Snow Globe
description: A glowing glass snow globe sits on a black base surrounded by colorful stones, succulents and holly. Inside the transparent sphere, a luminous white angel with rainbow-colored light rays extending from its body is surrounded by various fish and air bubbles against a deep purple background.
prompt: A magical crystal snow globe resting on a black base with holly and colorful gemstones on pink ground with succulents. Inside the clear glass orb, a translucent white angel figure with outstretched wings emits vibrant rainbow colored light beams.
